scope: Only CISA KEV listing claims explicitly identifiable from third-party headlines

findings.headline: Critical Atlassian Flaw CVE-2026-21589 Hits Eight Products and Lands on CISA’s Exploited List - TechNadu
findings.specific_claim: CISA lists CVE-2026-21589 in its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
findings.what_is_known: CISA's current KEV catalog lists this exact CVE with the stated addition date. This verifies listing only, not the article's additional claims.
findings.limitations: Headline discovery metadata only; news article body not independently retrieved. Catalog listing does not establish the scope, current exploit activity or impact on particular users.

coverage_note: Automated source-specific matching, not complete fact-checking, independent verification of every headline, or a full News Reader daily briefing.
